dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You picked a good moment — I actually have some snacks on me. You want some?

choices.text: Are they for feeding to saurians?

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: They're for whoever wants them. Me, you, or the saurians. It never hurts to carry some food with you.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Try this — it's some jerky that I grilled myself. It's really good, even if I do say so myself.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Yeah? I'm glad you like it. I also do other kinds with different seasonings. I'll bring a bigger variety next time we meet.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Uh, you can keep this bag of jerky, by the way. Next time you need to ingratiate yourself with a saurian, feed them some of this. It'll help.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Dunno if you have any immediate need for it, but... Anyway, hold onto it for now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks, Ifa! This is so thoughtful of you...

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Aw, I'm glad you think so.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: To tell you the truth, I was pretty all over the place as a kid. I only got my act together after becoming a vet.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Tragedy is unavoidable in life. But everything passes in time.

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Whatever difficulties you're facing in your own life, I wish you the very best in getting through them.

choices.text: Thank you, but... this is a little too chewy for me...

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Ah, whoops... I forgot, your teeth aren't nearly as sharp as a saurian's...

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Sorry about that. Let's try something else, then... I've also got some little cookies?

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Heh, hopefully a little easier on your teeth.
